items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I remember it being Herdick and Seamons. I remember that. That was a big name in burlesque at that time.

ctx.x: Now, do you remember in the Apollo Theater, was of course a Yiddish burlesque theater, then around 1934, I guess it was, the Shirmans took it over from Seaman & Herdic and it became black. But before that I found an ad in I think it was the Amsterdam News, that Bessie Smith appeared there. They had an all black show, and this was while

it was still Herdick and Seamon Seamon and Herdick, so this was before the Shifmans took it over and before it got a black policy. They obviously had tried out having black shows there. Do you remember any of this?
No. No. No. I remember it being Herdick and Seamons. I remember that. That was a big name in burlesque at that time.
